notes: DiscoFlate v3.84.8 — 🎬 An intro that ran out on its own clock never handed over. end_intro() cancelled the intro task — but when the countdown expires, end_intro is called FROM that task, so it cancelled itself, and the CancelledError landed on the very next await: the go-live handover. So the LIVE announcement with your command list never posted, its [!command] tokens never fired, and finish_activation() never released the events. Silently, because CancelledError is a BaseException and the guard there only caught Exception. Pressing Start now always worked, because that runs on a different task.
